title: Chat UI
description: An assistant or team chat: conversation list, thread with a typing or working state, composer with send and attach, the assistant's Mascot, every loading, empty and error state

quality.identity: An assistant has a face: Mascot in the header (state follows the work: thinking while it answers) and large in the empty state; the brand mark is Logo, never a drawn SVG
quality.states: Every view that loads data shows loading (Skeleton shaped like the content), empty (title, one line, the action that fills it), error (Feedback tone="danger" with Retry) and filled, through a typed lib/ data layer of async functions over mock data — even when the brief never mentions data
quality.sending: A sent message shows status sending, then sent; a failed one shows status failed with onRetry; attachments go through ChatComposer attach
quality.empty: An empty thread is a welcome: the Mascot, one question, and two to four suggestion Tags that send themselves
